violation_type.code_system: Texas Administrative Code, Title 26, Ch. HRC42
violation_type.original_code: HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the Li
violation_type.title: HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the License (Type of Children, Age Range) (26 TAC §HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the Li)
violation_type.short_title: HRC42.048(b) - AP Restrictions on the License (Type of Children, Age Range)
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection, a total of 9 infants with a specified age of 12-17 months  were observed to be in care in the infant room with two caregivers.  The infant capacity on the license/permit is 8. Therefore, the operation was in violation of the infant capacity restriction by one infant child.     This was corrected at inspection after one of the parents picked up one of the infant children.

finding_variants.text: During inspection, a total of 9 infants with a specified age of 12-17 months  were observed to be in care in the infant room with two caregivers.  The infant capacity on the license/permit is 8. Therefore, the operation was in violation of the infant capacity restriction by one infant child.     This was corrected at inspection after one of the parents picked up one of the infant children.
The operation was currently caring for Pre-K age children which they are not licensed for at time of inspection.
The center has an infant in care. The center is not licensed or equipped for infant care.
The operation was providing services to infants at inspection which is not authorized by the permit.
The operation was caring for 48 children. The licensed capacity for the operation is 44.    This was corrected during inspection when five children were taken on a field trip.
The center has two  infants in care. The center is not licensed or equipped for infant care. Equipment has been ordered.
